backend/main.mo: Actor storing user profiles, OTP challenges, balances, QR codes, and transaction records with bank-category listing and comparison helpers.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence linking profile-setup OTP changes to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file summarizing all frontend screens, hooks, and components for quick reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining color tokens and theming for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML document mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component controlling auth, profile setup flow, and main app rendering.
frontend/src/components/BalanceCard.tsx: Component displaying current balance with loading state and reward banner.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header showing app branding, user details dropdown, and logout logic.
Generates and displays a user payment QR code via external API with canvas fallback.
frontend/src/components/QRCodeScanner.ts: Provides a QR code scanner UI using useQRScanner, handling camera state, errors, and sending scanned mobile numbers upward.
frontend/src/components/SendMoneyCard.ts: Displays a form to send money, validates input, auto-fills mobile from QR scans, and triggers sendMoney mutations.
frontend/src/components/TransactionHisto: Fetches and displays sorted transaction history with loading skeletons and empty-state UI.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider managing identity loading, login, logout, and related state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for backend operations including profile, OTP, balance, transactions, and sending money, using the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and OKLCH-based color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/LoginScreen.tsx: Renders a stylized login screen with hero graphics and an Internet Identity login button.
frontend/src/pages/MainApp.tsx: Implements the main authenticated UI with tabs for home, sending money, scanning, QR generation, and history.
frontend/src/pages/ProfileSetupScreen.ts: Handles user onboarding with bank selection, OTP verification, and profile submission.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Customizes Tailwind with OKLCH CSS variables, animations, plugins, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current state, listing known issues around bank selection and OTP flows, existing frontend feature updates for OTP-based verification, and pending backend feature requests for OTP challenge support.
